caption: The drawing features five puppet-like heads, each distinct in appearance and attire, aligned in a single row against a plain, light beige background. The heads are exaggerated, with prominent facial features and expressive eyes. From left to right: the first head has light, curly hair, pinkish skin, thick eyebrows, and wears a dark garment; the second head has a long, pointed nose, grayish-white hair, a red-tipped nose, and chin, and is dressed in a patterned, multicolored garment; the central head has black hair parted in the middle, lighter skin with red undertones, large dark eyes, and a similar, ornate patterned garment; the fourth head is in profile, with a strongly hooked nose, white or blonde curled wig, and a formal black garment; the fifth head has short, brown spiked hair, a wide red mouth, lighter skin, and a black collar. The medium used appears to be watercolor or colored pencil, with details carefully applied to facial features, hair, and clothing. The signature "Frank H. Gray" is written at the lower right of the image.
title: Marionette (Details)
